RagShortTexts: Order and Samogitian forces need provisions in 1259.
Partners’ willingness affects the forces assembled.

Variants.Content: Order and Samogitian mobilization combines manpower, provisions and willing partners. Promised aid needs actual numbers, residence and supply. A local group may accept one operation without accepting every additional demand.
Early or late arrivals strain hosts. Waiting troops must preserve supplies and agree signals and positions with unfamiliar partners rather than trust a shared enemy alone.
Planning distinguishes committed participants from friendly labels. Disagreement over one objective need not end every form of cooperation; bounded terms preserve support.
Households feeding assemblies count remaining seed and fuel. If promised protection brings only extra demands, residents may evade deliveries.
